verdict.rationale: The evidence shows interactive API documentation with an API Explorer, per-method markdown reference pages, SDKs and an llms.txt file, but none of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. API Explorer and llms.txt are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
